title: Embeddings/Rerank: Fine-grained PII Logging Controls, Streamable Audit Events & Scalable Retention
creator: Marcus Lee
description:
Problem statement: Our embeddings and reranking endpoints currently emit rich telemetry and debug logs that can include raw user-provided text. For regulated customers and internal security posture we must provide deterministic, auditable ways to avoid persisting PII while keeping enough signal for performance debugging and quality monitoring.

Scope: Implement a privacy-first pipeline that: (1) classifies and optionally redacts or tokenizes PII before it reaches long-term logs or metrics indices; (2) emits streamable audit events that contain a verifiable index of retention decisions (redacted/hashed/kept) and reason codes; (3) supports configurable retention windows per workspace and per-route; (4) preserves low-latency and high-throughput characteristics of the embeddings/rerank service (no >5% tail latency regression at p95); (5) integrates with existing KMS and audit log storage backends.

Design notes and decisions to date: We will implement a two-stage pipeline: (A) real-time scrubber within the request path that runs a fast, probabilistic PII classifier and applies an action map (redact/hash/anonymize/allow) based on workspace policy; (B) a background publisher that writes compact audit events (limited to metadata, policy decision, and a hashed payload fingerprint) to the audit sink. We choose probabilistic classifier + deterministic hashing to keep latency low but enable later forensic reconstruction when a customer grants access (via secure key exchange). For very high-sensitivity customers, an opt-in "no-text-retention" mode will strip and only emit tokenized embeddings and policy metadata.

Trade-offs: Strict redaction (remove entire input) guarantees privacy but harms debugability and quality monitoring. Deterministic hashing keeps a stable identifier but still carries re-identification risk if combined with external datasets; therefore hashing keys are tenant-scoped and rotated. We intentionally avoid sending full raw text to the audit sink except behind an explicit legal/ops flow.

Compatibility: The endpoint API surface is unchanged for callers. New behavior is controlled by per-workspace policy flags and a header for explicit developer opt-in for "debug-text" with justification. Existing telemetry consumers should continue to work; we will add new fields to audit events with backward-compatible names and document them.

Rollout plan: feature-flag behind workspace policy -> internal dogfood on staging -> opt-in alpha with 3 pilot customers -> gradual rollout to all paid workspaces with default conservative policy.

Performance goals: p50/p95 tokenization overhead <3ms/<12ms; overall p95 request latency regression <=5%; added storage cost for audit events <10% of current logging spend for typical workloads.
acceptance_criteria: Per-workspace policy UI accepts retention window and PII action mappings and persists config
Real-time scrubber applies policy in-line and emits an event with decision_code and fingerprint within request lifecycle
Audit event schema published and streamable to audit sinks (CloudWatch/BigQuery/S3) without raw-text unless explicit opt-in is active
End-to-end latency regression measured and within targets (p95 <= +5%) under representative load
Unit and integration tests cover all action map branches (redact/hash/allow/anonymize)
Security review completed and crypto key rotation for hashing keys implemented
Pilot with at least 3 customers completed and feedback incorporated into default policy
tasks: Design scrubber action map and default policies (privacy team + PM)
Implement fast PII classifier module (C++/Rust) with lightweight model and FFI bindings
Integrate scrubber into embeddings/rerank request path with hooks for feature flagging
Create audit event schema and publisher service (streaming, backpressure aware)
Add workspace-level policy storage and Console UI controls (Product + Console)
Implement deterministic hashing with tenant-scoped keys and rotation APIs
Load-test pipeline to validate latency & throughput under production traffic patterns
Prepare migration docs, runbook for opt-in raw-text access, and legal approval flow
End-to-end QA and security review sign-off

2026-03-10 Dogfood: internal staging rollout with two teams. Observed a small spike in logging cost due to verbose decision metadata; trimmed fields and added efficient encoding for fingerprint. See GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4387

2026-03-12 QA: Integration tests green. Noted edge case where very long inputs (>64k chars) caused classifier timeout; mitigation: sample-prefix classifier + async fallback. Added task to handle long inputs.
